name: Detachable desk lamp

baseline.Adjustment: Tilting head and adjustable desk stand
baseline.Controls: Physical power/brightness control; no app required
baseline.Charging: USB-C for detachable light; cable and USB power adapter included (proposed)
baseline.Battery target: Four hours at 100 lumens; full-output runtime unverified

standout: Detachable rechargeable light head that works on its included mini stand away from the desk base.
selling_point: One desk light that moves with your work.

negative_features.comparison: Below sampled median 420 lm and Lepro detailed specification of 750 lm; above IKEA 170 lm.
negative_features.reason: Deliberate light-output limitation, relevant to large work areas.

negative_features.feature: Fixed 2700 K warm-white light; no color-temperature selection
negative_features.comparison: OttLite offers three modes and Lepro five; IKEA is also fixed 2700 K.
negative_features.reason: Deliberate loss of color-temperature flexibility; may suit evening readers.

design_notes: Price equals sampled median. Brightness and color-mode count deliberately depart from sampled medians. Detachability and battery performance are unverified concept engineering targets. The three-brand price sample spans budget to premium; not a representative market median.
research_question: Which purchasing situations prefer this offer over alternatives, and does the marketed feature compensate for the deliberate tradeoffs?
experiments: Same offer with versus without marketed standout
Compare by segment without predetermining launch outcome
